name: My Dear Disy
greetingText: I Hope You Liked Your Flowers.
wishText:
You really are so special to me. I’ve never quite grasped how someone could be so drawn to another person because I’ve never experienced such patience and compassion, but with you I feel so utterly helpless in the fact that I know you care and I know just how much I care. Yes, I’m guarded, and yes, you’re not so much; but the way you effortlessly let me in is so admirable. You’re this huge array of wonderful that I’ve not come across in my life thus far. You’re so deep and in tune with what makes you you, and I love that so much about you. I’ll be honest—before we reconnected, I thought your nerdy interests were silly. Now that I’ve been let into your world, I love all your hobbies and niches so much, and I can definitely see why you cherish them the way you do. That in itself—learning that about you—has taught me that my silly interests aren’t so silly, and it just took time and effort to see that.You’ve allowed me to open myself up in ways that allow me to be just me. You’ve allowed me to see into you in ways that have literally reverted me back to the person I am, and not someone trying to front for your approval. Your eagerness to learn and improve has inspired me to take on new things and new adventures with you, and that said, if it wasn’t because of you, I probably never would’ve. You’re so much more than your insecurities; the things that question you are the difficulties that I love about you. Your diverse mind and functions are personable traits that I appreciate, traits that make up the whole you. I welcome every part of you. You’re not just around for my benefit, but you do benefit me. You inspire me to be better, you inspire me to learn, you inspire me to intertwine myself and take part in all of what makes you you.
In this moment of my life, I am confident in one choice: furthering and continuing what we have right now. You are such an amazingly complex person, and I wish only to thrive in your presence and know more about you. I genuinely don’t understand how the people previous to me haven’t felt the weight of your character—haven’t been fully entranced by your everything. You’re nothing shy of always being there, and their lack of respect towards you is boggling. I have only the best intentions when interacting with you and only wish to give you what you deserve. Albeit I am not the perfect person, you drive me to strive for better within myself because you are better. You’re better than most, and I am not trying to let that die down easily. You’re welcome here in my circle—you’re welcome in your entirety, your good, your bad, and your confusing. I’m here to grow with you, but if by any chance all of this is called to a halt, I’m grateful to look back and see my progress within your kindness. I love the person you are today. I love how you make me feel. You matter; you deserve more than you’ve ever been handed.
My dearest Girl, You are the most precious person in my life. You are the reason why i wake up every morning with a smile on my face. You are the source of my happiness and joy. You are the light of my world and the warmth of my heart. I want you to know how much i appreciate you and everything you do for me. You are always there to support me, encourage me, comfort me, and inspire me. You are always understanding, patient, kind, and generous. You are always loyal, faithful, honest, and respectful. You are everything i have dreamed of and more. You have no idea of how much you mean to me. You have no idea of how much you affect me. You have no idea of how you make me feel. You make me feel alive, you make me feel loved, you make me feel special, you make me feel beautiful. You are the best thing that has ever happend to me. You are the best gift i’ve ever recived. You are the best girl i’ve ever found. You are my other half, you are my perfect match. You are my companion, my confidant, my ally. My partner in crime, my partner in life. You are my everything, my all, my only. I can’t imagine a life without you. I can’t imagine a day without seeing your face, hearing your voice, smelling your scent. You are the only one who can make me laugh when im sad, make me calm when im angry, make me brave when im scared, make me strong when im weak, make me better when im broken. You are the only one who can understand me, respect me, trust me. You are the only one who can make me happy, and i want to make you happy too. I want to be there for you, as long as you’re there for me. I want to support you, as you support me. I want to encourage you, as you encourage me. I want to comfort you, as you comfort me. I want to inspire you, as you inspire me. I want to share the rest of my life with you. I want to grow old with you.
